known.summary: The loop of `trailing` runs only while `start > 1`, so it never takes the chunk at index 0. When a heading starts the text, as `# Title` on line 1 does, its text chunks start at index 0, `trailing` returns null, and `scanHeadings` reports that heading as a heading with raw inline HTML and does not count it. So a check that needs the title heading of a text fails on a valid text that begins with that heading. The pull request adds markdownHeadings.ts: the base has no such file and no heading scan through the Bun parser.
